column1: # merge-pr: is this pre-flip check one marking the draft ready has to re-run, so
# the merge waits for it? Read by BOTH ports (awaits_flip / Test-AwaitsFlip). The
# checks waited for are the ones the draft SKIPPED whose workflow names
# ready_for_review (ready-trigger.tsv answers that per file); a workflow with the
# trigger but no check on the head - one whose `paths:` this change misses - is
# never asked, so it is never expected. A false yes holds the merge for a run that
# never comes and refuses it; a false no merges before the flip's CI has run.
# "\n" separates the ready workflows' names, "-" is an empty string.
